description: Unseen holdout evaluation dataset for testing generalizability of orchestrator routing logic.

queries.query: Where is the hydraulic oil filler nut located on the BPROSP20T model and how do I open it?
queries.ground_truth_notes: Must cite BPROSP20TManual.pdf for oil filler nut location on reservoir and instructions for removing the nut/screw to inspect fluid level.

queries.query: What is the step-by-step procedure in the manual for storing the press when not in use?
queries.ground_truth_notes: Must cite manual storage recommendations: fully retracting ram/piston, closing release valve, wiping clean, storing in clean dry area.

queries.query: Are operators required to wear safety footwear and eye protection when operating the press?
queries.ground_truth_notes: Must reference hydraulic-press.pdf PPE requirements: safety shoes/footwear, safety glasses/eye protection, avoiding loose clothing around pinch points.

queries.query: Is it permissible to bypass the daily pre-operation visual inspection if the press ran without issues on the previous shift?
queries.ground_truth_notes: Must be non-compliant. Cite Guidelines-on-Safe-Use-of-Press-Machines-2015.pdf requiring daily visual inspections before work begins regardless of prior shift performance.

queries.query: We noticed a puddle of hydraulic oil around the base of the press frame after heavy pressing operations — have we seen cylinder seal leaks like this before?
queries.ground_truth_notes: Must match RL-2024-007: oil pooling at cylinder base during high-load 20-ton straightening, replaced cylinder rod seal and installed alignment guide.

queries.query: The press bed seems unlevel and workpieces are tilting to one side under load — what resolved this in past maintenance records?
queries.ground_truth_notes: Must match RL-2024-005: bed frame misalignment, re-torqued floor anchor bolts, replaced lifting bar bushings, realigned bed plates.

queries.query: The hydraulic oil smells burnt and the pump reservoir feels uncomfortably hot after continuous production runs — any prior repair logs for this?
queries.ground_truth_notes: Must match RL-2024-012: hydraulic fluid overheating after ~30 continuous production cycles, changed oil and instituted mandatory cool-down intervals.

queries.query: Fluid is leaking near the pump fitting and the ram is creeping down. Is it safe to keep running production while we check past repair logs?
queries.ground_truth_notes: Requires all three agents: active leakage + ram creep + safety question ('is it safe'). Must advise stopping production immediately.

queries.query: We need to check the oil capacity specification in the manual and also search if we've ever replaced pump seals for low pressure before.
queries.ground_truth_notes: Explicitly requests manual oil specs (researcher) AND past repair history for pump seal replacements (troubleshooter RL-2024-006).

queries.query: What does the manual say about positioning the work bed plate, and is it compliant to operate if the interlocked guard is removed?
queries.ground_truth_notes: Requests manual instructions for bed plate placement (researcher) AND safety compliance ruling on operating without interlocked guards (auditor).
